title: zone-south-7 streaming pipeline broken
description: The real-time data streaming pipeline in zone-south-7 stopped processing events at 11:30 UTC. Kafka consumers are disconnected from brokers. No new events are being delivered to downstream analytics services.

title: Data lake ingestion halted in zone-south-7
description: The data lake ingestion service in zone-south-7 has stopped processing new batches since 11:28 UTC. The service depends on the zone-south-7 storage layer which is returning I/O errors. Approximately 2TB of data is waiting to be ingested.

title: Real-time analytics dashboard offline — zone-south-7
description: The real-time analytics dashboard backed by zone-south-7 infrastructure has been offline since 11:32 UTC. The dashboard API returns connection errors when querying the zone-south-7 metrics store. Executive team relies on this for daily standups.

title: Feature request: auto-scaling policy for zone-south-7 compute
description: We'd like to implement auto-scaling for the zone-south-7 compute cluster. Current manual scaling is slow during traffic spikes. Please evaluate Kubernetes HPA with custom metrics. Target: next quarter roadmap.

title: Low-priority: update DNS records for zone-south-7 staging
description: The staging environment DNS records for zone-south-7 need updating to reflect the new IP ranges assigned last month. This only affects internal developer access to staging — no production impact.
